productSpec.name: ClipCast
productSpec.thesis: Solo podcasters spend 2+ hours per episode finding good clips and creating vertical videos. Existing tools (Descript, Opus) are complex and expensive.
productSpec.mvpFeatures:
- Upload audio/video file
- AI finds top 5 clip-worthy moments
- Generate vertical video with captions
- Export to TikTok/Reels/Shorts formats
productSpec.distribution: Post in podcasting subreddits, Facebook groups, own podcast

founderContext.domainExperience: Host podcast for 3 years (200+ episodes), tried every clip tool
founderContext.existingAudience: 5K podcast listeners, 1.5K Twitter followers, member of 4 podcasting communities
